title: A Framework for Taking Actions
author: We Made People
summary: This brief devotional offers a three-part framework for getting unstuck when worried, overwhelmed, or overthinking a decision: ask what kind of thing you are dealing with. Settled Things are already decided—birth family, past decisions, providence—and call for acceptance and learning rather than futile attempts to undo them. Action Things are genuine controllables—diet, habits, work ethic, attitude, skills—where the right response is direct action, started small if necessary. Prayer Things lie outside your control but within God’s—the economy, timing, other people’s choices, open and closed doors—where the response is prayer, patience, and faithful preparation. The author acknowledges the framework is deliberately reductionistic; its goal is not to explain life’s complexity but to get the reader moving by categorising the issue and acting accordingly.
points: The framework hinges on one diagnostic question: “What kind of thing am I dealing with?” Most issues fall into one of three categories.
Settled Things are already decided (birth, upbringing, past choices, providence)—the response is acceptance, not undoing.
Action Things are real controllables (diet, habits, attitude, skills)—the response is direct action, started small if needed.
Prayer Things are outside your control but within God’s (economy, timing, others’ choices)—the response is prayer, waiting, and faithful preparation.
The framework is intentionally reductionistic; its purpose is not to explain every complexity but simply to get the reader unstuck and moving.
quotes: Here’s a simple way to get unstuck when you’re worried, overwhelmed, or overthinking a decision.
The question is, “Does this have any bearing on what I should do now?
Start small if you have to. Make the call. Go on the walk. Open the Bible. Apologize. Apply for the job.
These are things outside your direct control, but not outside God’s control.
Most people waste too much energy trying to change the past, control what belongs to God, or pray about things they simply need to obey.
Accept what is settled. Act on what is yours. Pray over what belongs to God.
